register.title: Evan Daniel's regularized views at 175, 204, 268, 293, 303 and 304 at bb4cc78, issue 914
register.headline: Daniel's regularized views of his new packings of 175, 204, 268, 293, 303 and 304 squares, each at its certificate's side
register.source_checks: The issue says the source's two exact checkers, search/exact/verify_cert.py (separating axes) and verify_cert2.py (polygon intersection), byte-identical to the copies the n183 packet retains, both report VALID on all thirteen certificate files, the seven certificates and six regularized views, and that they share an author and the certificate format. It calls the certificates at 175, 204, 268, 293, 303 and 304 exact KKT points, with numerical evidence at 80 digits, not interval proofs: strict local minima of S modulo 57, 17 and 103 exact flat motions at 204, 293 and 304; positive semidefinite with 83 zero modes at 175; inconclusive at 268; and at 303 a KKT point that a first-order corner-corner MILP descent, not realised, shows is not established as a local minimum. At 260 the exact solver did not converge, and the issue says the certificate dilates the f64 packing by 8.8e-12; measured here, it dilates its binary64 input, s260_ks_1105.input.txt, by the factor 1 + 1e-12, its side 1.66e-11 above the input's, and 8.8e-12 is its side's excess over the pre-descent input's (F3 of the 5 November review). Local optimality is not established there. The commit ends with a Co-Authored-By trailer naming Claude. Those statements are the author's; no source program ran here.
register.credit: Credit Evan Daniel (https://github.com/evand/square-packing), whose fault-line composer, his independent implementation of Chris Deotte's multi-gadget fault DP from Deotte's Kaggle notebooks, built all seven, with Chris Deotte credited for the method as the issue asks: at 175 from gadgets of the register's s(175) packing (Daniil Ostashev's, as PingYou Ltd and Mykhailo Polkovskyi refined it) and an earlier composer build at 175, the register's packing credited as the start; at 204 from gadgets of Daniel's own s(233) and s(370), with no public start known; at 260 the tilted island of Daniel's #845 260, recomposed in a 260 frame, with that packing's credit, Kirill Tymchishin's (kirilltym) Kaggle s(260) as the start; and at 268, 293, 303 and 304 composer builds whose gadget donors were not recorded, with no public start known. The issue calls all seven new packings, none a refinement of the register's. Kaggle per-puzzle sides it quotes at all seven counts state no packing and are no report. The source's credits say its work was produced by Claude (Anthropic) under human direction.
register.next_rung: Independently review the retained replay and the certificates (stage 4): a clean-room exact checker, the identity against each house's packing and the lineage the source states, a mapped review whose acceptance would raise both rungs. Then adopt each certificate at its count under the house rule, replacing T-186 at 175, T-264 at 204, T-265 at 260, T-242 at 268 and 304, T-257 at 293 and T-240 at 303, with both strong generators' regularization and the flip of each new house in the same change.
